items.source: 新浪潮牌速递 (Sina Fashion Express) via Weibo
items.title: 古驰国内国外价差到底多大？2026年9月降价后最高省40%
items.summary: Weibo fashion-commerce account breaks down Gucci's early-September 2026 mainland China price cuts: Mercato small tote down ~27% (RMB25,500 to 20,000), Ophidia mini bucket bag down over 40% to RMB8,700, GG Marmont small bucket bag to RMB8,100. Frames domestic boutiques as now offering better value than daigou resellers, narrowing the historic 20-40% price gap with overseas markets.

items.source: 奢圈观察 (Luxury Circle Observer) via Weibo
items.title: 古驰大降价+新总监首秀，能重现辉煌吗？3个维度深度解读
items.summary: Weibo commentary account links Demna's Gucci Primavera collection debut with the concurrent 27-40% price cuts, citing Gucci's H1 2026 revenue reported down 9% (5% like-for-like) and Asia-Pacific down 10%, framing the discounting as part of Kering's 'Rinascimento' repricing strategy rather than a short-term promotion. Piece is skeptical whether design change plus price cuts can restore the brand's standing.

items.source: PR TIMES / Kering Japan press release
items.title: グッチ アイウェア 2026年秋冬コレクションの新キャンペーン発表
items.summary: Kering Japan's official press release unveils Gucci's Fall/Winter 2026 eyewear campaign shot by Mark Seliger with art direction by Riccardo Zanola, featuring double-G acetate frames and horsebit-detail sunglasses for men and women. Official brand marketing push, not independent commentary.

items.title: 연말 시즌 앞두고 명품 가격 'N차 인상'···"한국만 배짱장사" 비판 확산
items.summary: Korean consumer-economy outlet reports mounting criticism that luxury houses including Gucci repeatedly raise prices in Korea without notice ahead of year-end shopping season, with consumers accusing brands of treating the Korean market as an easy target ('배짱장사'/audacious profiteering) versus other regions.

items.title: "84곳 문 닫았다"…매장 줄이는 명품 브랜드의 속내
items.summary: Hankyung reports Kering group closed 84 stores globally in H1 2026 (targeting 100 by year-end, ~5% of directly operated locations), part of an industry-wide shift from expansion to concentrating investment in flagship stores in cities like Seoul, Beijing and Tokyo while shuttering underperforming locations, implicating Gucci's own store-network contraction in Asia.

items.source: 奢圈观察-style Weibo account (亚太地位下滑 thread)
items.title: 古驰在奢侈品行业地位下滑：从顶奢跌至第二梯队
items.summary: Weibo discussion thread argues Gucci has slipped from top-tier to second-tier luxury status in Chinese consumer perception, citing prior record revenue declines; comment-style content reflects community sentiment that consumers now discuss Gucci online but hesitate to buy at full price, and welcome discounting as validation of the brand's decline in status.
